references.text: The description of the incense altar from which the coals were taken, and its function in the sanctuary.
The recipe for the fragrant incense (קְטֹרֶת סַמִּים) to be used in the sanctuary.
The description of the veil (פָּרֹכֶת) that separated the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.
Nadab and Abihu offered strange fire before the Lord, contrasting with the proper way to carry fire from the altar.
Aaron took a censer with fire from the altar and incense to make atonement, corresponding to the ritual on the Day of Atonement.
The use of censers (מַחְתָּה) in connection with the priests' service.
The angel with a golden censer and incense before God's throne, an image reflecting the high priest's service with incense on the Day of Atonement.
Hebrews mentions the censer and the Most Holy Place in connection with the sanctuary of the old covenant.
